summary: Bind the generator's newNovel<Name>Cmd hooks to the hand-authored commands, register `open` and the official-CLI aliases through registerNovelCommand, keep run/price/schema/upload/download printing their payload (not the generated {meta, results} envelope), and stop run --dry-run from polling, downloading, or recording.
reason: The reprint keeps root.go fully generated. Scripts parse `price --agent`, `schema --agent`, and `run --agent` output directly, so those documents keep the 2026.10.1 shape. `run --dry-run --wait` previously exited 5 trying to poll a prediction that was never submitted.
validated_outcome: compat_test.py (old 2026.10.1 vs reprint) is green: no command or flag removed except the hollow `api` browser, JSON keys unchanged for account-balance, billings, models, price, schema, and run --dry-run, and all 11 script invocations pass.
